subject: Nanotechnology
title: Conductance Quantization
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Conductance Quantization.

hook.text: Narrow a wire to just a few atoms wide and its conductance jumps in discrete steps — like a staircase.

buildup.text: In a quantum point contact, electrons pass through one-dimensional channels — each channel has a fixed conductance.

discovery.text: Each channel contributes exactly 2e²/h — a universal quantum of conductance, regardless of material.

twist.text: Adding or removing one atomic row opens or closes a channel — conductance jumps, never slides.

climax.text: Conductance quantization proved that atoms matter individually — bulk averaging no longer applies.

punchline.text: Narrow a wire to atoms and conductance counts in steps.

quiz.question: What is the quantum of conductance?
options: The minimum voltage needed to start current flow
A fixed conductance value (2e²/h) per transport channel
The resistance of a single carbon nanotube
